study_status: post-audit locked cross-cycle re-evaluation; cycles share the NHANES program and outcome construction

frozen_configuration.prior_cycle_exposure: Cycles E and G appeared in earlier ancillary truncation and subgroup analyses; the present participant-level final-workflow scoring was locked, but is not a pristine independent validation.

c1_ratio_correction_provenance.training_scope: Cycle F TRAIN incomplete manoeuvres only

endpoint_routing.complete: direct observed FEV1, FVC, and ratio
endpoint_routing.incomplete: direct observed FEV1 divided by physics-recovered FVC, followed by Cycle F TRAIN correction

state_aware_physics_ratio_calibration.training_scope: Cycle F TRAIN incomplete manoeuvres only

scientific_conclusion.evidence_summary: The corrected measurement-state implementation routes complete manoeuvres to direct endpoints and incomplete manoeuvres to observed FEV1 with recovered FVC. The standalone physics branch did not exceed state-aware ridge at matched coverage. A Cycle-F-trained physics-plus-ridge hybrid is reported separately to test whether recovered FVC contributes incremental endpoint information beyond the clinical and waveform-prefix features already available to ridge. Agreement selection is retained as a distinct reliability analysis.
scientific_conclusion.interpretation_rule: Physics is credited with incremental predictive value only when its paired cross-cycle difference excludes zero or when it supplies a separately measured advantage in endpoint error, deferral safety, or robustness.
scientific_conclusion.implementation_revision: Post-audit correction: prior scoring applied physics-derived endpoints to complete manoeuvres and used modeled FEV1. Current scoring uses direct complete endpoints and observed FEV1 for censored recovery. The archived prior outputs are retained under results/pre_state_routing_audit.
